full_judgment:
This criminal petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 10-3-2019 passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 57533 of 2018 grating bail to respondent No. 1. 

 2. We have heard the learned Counsel of both the parties and perused the application. The learned Counsel appearing for respondent No. 1 submits that respondent No. 1 is a lady who has been suffering from various ailments. Having gone through the FIR we find that there is specific allegation against respondent No. 1 and that if she is enlarged on bail the investigation of this case may be jeopardized. In the facts and circumstances of the case, respondent No. 1 is not entitled to get the benefit of the proviso to sub-section (1) of section 497 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. 

 3. Considering all aspects of the case, the impugned judgment and order of the High Court Division is set aside and respondent No. 1. Mrs Jesmin Islam wife of Md Tanvir Mahmud is directed to surrender before the learned Metropolitan Senior Special Judge, Dhaka within 4 (four) weeks from the date failing which the said Court shall take appropriate steps to bring her in jail custody.
